about: Placeholders in this repo and what each stands for. Copy to placeholders.local.json, put your values in, then run tools/fill_placeholders.py placeholders.local.json.

placeholders.__WORKSPACE__: absolute path of this repo on your Mac (default: the repo's folder)
placeholders.__PYTHON3__: absolute path of python3, 3.13 from python.org (default: python3 on PATH)
placeholders.app.company.example: app host named in a test
placeholders.company.example: the company's mail and web domain (anything not listed above)
placeholders.a0000001-0000-4000-8000-000000000001: QA_ test site your engine account may write in (engine.json, cases)
placeholders.a0000002-0000-4000-8000-000000000002: site holding the terrain test flight (TERR cases)
placeholders.a0000005-0000-4000-8000-000000000005: second map attached to that flight
placeholders.a0000006-0000-4000-8000-000000000006: ClickUp custom field: test location (Hover's Today view)
placeholders.a0000007-0000-4000-8000-000000000007: ClickUp option of that field: office
placeholders.a0000009-0000-4000-8000-000000000009: ClickUp option used in a test
placeholders.a000000b-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b: flight id named in a gate test
